name: liquid-logo
title: Liquid Logo
description: A canvas that renders an image as a glossy, melting surface, bending its shape and adding thin iridescent highlights that drift over it.
use: A brand mark should feel premium and moving rather than a static SVG.
avoid: It needs a square WebGL canvas and an image with a clean alpha shape to read well.
a11y: A decorative WebGL canvas with no label, no reduced-motion check and a looping render. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two interlocking rounded black tiles form an offset plus shape on a dark stage. Their surface looks like polished chrome, with a white sheen and a thin rainbow band running along the inner edges.
behaves: The chrome surface ripples continuously, sliding its bright highlights and rainbow fringes along the shape. The silhouette wobbles slightly but stays recognisable.
customise: imageUrl plus patternScale, refraction, edge, patternBlur, liquid, speed and showProcessing are props; the shaders are fixed.
weight: heavy: A WebGL2 fragment shader redrawn every frame via requestAnimationFrame.
